sources.title: Close to Home Fishing
sources.geography: Named Two Rivers, Algoma, Kewaunee, Manitowoc access rows
sources.mode: Pier, breakwall and shore; separate upriver rows
sources.claim: Two Rivers harbor: rainbow/brown trout, bullhead, carp; Algoma Ahnapee mouth: rainbow trout, northern pike, common carp uncertain; Kewaunee river mouth: brown trout, northern pike; Manitowoc Marina: smallmouth bass, northern pike, rainbow/brown trout.
sources.use: Named access and local species association
sources.limits: Three listed species columns are not a complete inventory, target-effort sample, annual chronology, or catch rate. Grouped trout label does not independently quantify brown and rainbow.

sources.title: Lake Michigan Outdoor Fishing Report, September 7, 2026
sources.method: Creel-clerk field observations on randomized work schedules
sources.geography: Algoma, Kewaunee, and Manitowoc County sections
sources.mode: Explicit pier/harbor, river, and boat passages
sources.claim: Algoma pier anglers targeted trout and salmon; Ahnapee River anglers targeted perch and had perch/smallmouth. Kewaunee harbor/pier anglers targeted trout/salmon with Chinook in same paragraph. Manitowoc County piers produced pike, smallmouth and about ten Chinook.
sources.use: Dated exact-city target context for Algoma/Kewaunee; county pier species corroboration for Two Rivers/Manitowoc
sources.limits: One late-summer week. Kewaunee Chinook catch is not unambiguously assigned to the pier rather than the adjoining harbor. Manitowoc County does not separate its two cities. Offshore 3-5 Chinook per trip and river perch/smallmouth must not transfer to piers.

sources.title: Lake Michigan salmon and trout harvest tables, 1998–2024
sources.method: Annual creel estimates of harvested salmonids by county and angler mode
sources.geography: Kewaunee County pools Algoma and Kewaunee; Manitowoc County pools Two Rivers and Manitowoc
sources.claim: County pier harvest recurs for Chinook, brown trout, rainbow trout and coho. Lake-trout pier harvest occurred in older years, including Kewaunee County 2012/2015/2016 and Manitowoc County 2015/2019, but both counties show zero in 2022-24.
sources.use: County-mode recurrence and conservative context, not exact-city magnitude
sources.limits: Harvest not all catch or target effort; no city or pier split; no month in this table; estimated zero is not biological absence.
